facts.fact: 里奥斯已经是第三次被派出去追捕维克托·维尔。
facts.anchor: Three times she’d been sent into the field in search of Victor Vale.

facts.fact: 第三次线报是个陷阱，那地方在他们进入时被布置好要炸。
facts.anchor: It was a setup, the whole place rigged to blow the moment they went in.

facts.fact: 这次行动里一名队员在医务室处理烧伤。
facts.anchor: one was in medical being treated for burns

facts.fact: 里奥斯是第一个被发警徽而不是关进牢房的 EO。
facts.anchor: She was the first EO to ever be offered a badge instead of a cell.

facts.fact: EON 的八十名士兵里四十七人守院区、三十三人是外勤探员。
facts.anchor: forty-seven were guards stationed at the compound, and thirty-three were agents in the field

facts.fact: 三十三名外勤里三十一人是普通人，另两个是 EO。
facts.anchor: thirty-one were ordinary humans, and the other two were EOs

facts.fact: 诺亚的能力是制造幻象式的伪装：人还在，只是看不见。
facts.anchor: One moment he was there and the next, he wasn’t.

facts.fact: 里奥斯的能力来自一次轰炸中被压在房屋废墟下、险些丧命。
facts.anchor: nearly being crushed beneath the rubble of a house when it was bombed
